source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

intelligence.enrichment: Particles of liquids and gases are in constant motion; moving water particles spread potassium permanganate through water, moving gas particles spread fragrance through air, and hotter water spreads the colour faster because its particles move faster. constant particle motion, with faster motion at higher temperature -> spreading and mixing through the available liquid or gas The learner predicts spreading of colour or fragrance from constant particle motion and predicts fastest colour spreading in hot water because hotter particles move faster. Colour or fragrance spreads only when someone stirs, blows, or carries it across the space.
